variables.n: physical sites, modes, ports or carrier degrees of freedom
variables.k: frequency, time, momentum or path-grid points
variables.s: independent samples, shots, disorder realizations or trajectories
variables.D(n): many-body Hilbert-space dimension, generally exponential at fixed filling

rules: Fixed-size exact execution is not evidence of scalable access.
Shot-noise scaling s=O(epsilon^-2) is a baseline, not a promise in the presence of drift or correlated noise.
A polynomial forward model does not make parameter identifiability or global model selection polynomial.
Full state, process or logical tomography is presumed exponential unless a sufficient restricted record is proved.
Unknown fabrication yield, continuum convergence and condition-number growth remain unknown rather than O(1).

cards.asymptoticConclusion: The certified three-mode selector is fixed-size exact. A scalable selector remains polynomial only with local or low-rank system identification; unrestricted process tomography grows exponentially with carrier dimension.

existence.scaling: local return-map and stability certificates use sparse O(n^3) linear algebra
existence.approximationError: controlled by residual and spectral-gap bounds
existence.basis: exact finite return map and Hessian certificates

preparation.scaling: O(n) calibrated local components if a modular carrier exists; yield and cross-talk scaling are unmeasured

sampling.scaling: O(k epsilon^-2) trajectories per initial-condition family under independent-noise sampling
sampling.approximationError: shot noise plus mixing and drift bias

detection.scaling: O(m k epsilon^-2) for the declared projector, phase and population records

verification.scaling: O(n^3 + m k epsilon^-2) for local transfer reconstruction, held-out initial states and datum-removal control
verification.approximationError: confidence interval on contraction and neutral-manifold control
verification.basis: independent system-identification path; full process tomography is excluded

cards.independentVerification: Fit local transfer elements on one set of trajectories, predict held-out initial projectors, then remove the second datum and recover neutral orientation.
cards.killTest: The only verification route is unrestricted process tomography, or apparent contraction vanishes under held-out initialization and loss controls.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Inverse detector design is tractable for a finite preregistered mechanism library and differentiable nuisance model. It is not a global injectivity theorem over unrestricted mechanisms.

existence.scaling: O(p^3 + m p^2) for Fisher/Schur rank tests

preparation.scaling: O(m) control settings for a declared candidate detector

sampling.scaling: O(m epsilon^-2) baseline, multiplied by mixing time or rare-event factor

detection.scaling: O(s m p) score evaluation after forward simulation

verification.scaling: O(L m s) for L preregistered mechanisms plus adversarial held-out pairs
verification.basis: blind simulation challenge and independent nuisance fit

cards.independentVerification: A second implementation generates blinded raw records from held-out mechanisms; the proposed added channel must separate them after nuisance refitting.
cards.killTest: The target score lies in the nuisance span, or success depends on an unrestricted hidden oracle choosing the correct mechanism family.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Tensor acquisition, Lifshitz propagation and differential-force sampling are polynomial in the declared grid and precision. Reproducible matched-film preparation and broadband tail control do not yet have a defensible asymptotic law.

existence.scaling: O(k p^3) causal tensor fitting and quadrature on a fixed model family
existence.basis: causal response plus Lifshitz forward model

preparation.scaling: matched-film yield versus area, thickness and domain count is not established
preparation.approximationError: sample mismatch, domains, roughness and contamination

sampling.scaling: O(k m epsilon^-2) spectroscopy and force repeats before drift overhead
sampling.approximationError: correlated drift may exceed shot-noise scaling
sampling.basis: finite frequency, angle and separation grid

detection.scaling: O(k m) calibrated transport/optical/force records per sample

verification.scaling: O(k p^3 + k m epsilon^-2) no-refit prediction on held-out separations and angles
verification.approximationError: propagated tensor covariance plus nuisance envelope
verification.basis: independent force apparatus and matched witness films

cards.independentVerification: Freeze the tensor and covariance before force data are opened; predict held-out angle/separation bins and repeat on a witness film from the same growth run.
cards.killTest: Allowed optical tails, patch potentials, domains or ordinary magnetic forces span the signal, or material matching requires post-force refitting.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Exact and matrix-free source-native calculations remain exponential in site count through D(n), even when polynomial in the represented Hilbert dimension. Low-frequency thermodynamic rank is therefore externally gated by symmetry reduction, distributed typicality or a new approximation theorem.

existence.scaling: D(n) grows combinatorially at fixed filling; exact diagonalization is at least polynomial in D(n)
existence.approximationError: zero for the finite oracle but no thermodynamic inference

preparation.scaling: state/vector memory O(D(n)); sparse Hamiltonian and current assembly O(poly(n) D(n))
preparation.approximationError: operator convention exact after source audit
preparation.basis: compiled symmetry sector still exponential asymptotically

sampling.scaling: KPM/typicality O(r k poly(n) D(n)) with stochastic-vector count r
sampling.approximationError: O(r^-1/2) stochastic plus kernel, broadening and finite-size bias

detection.scaling: O(k) once the 2x2 spectral block is produced
detection.basis: determinant and normalized determinant are low-dimensional records

verification.scaling: independent exact small-cluster reconstruction plus sum rules; larger-size reproduction inherits D(n)
verification.approximationError: gauge, moment and size residuals remain separately bounded
verification.basis: exact oracle, continuity identities and independent estimator

cards.independentVerification: Reproduce the 3x3 block/cross spectrum on exact clusters, enforce sum rules and gauge convergence, then compare an independently compiled common-sample estimator.
cards.killTest: Any claimed scalable result hides D(n), uses different random samples for cross channels, or infers dc rank from integrated moments alone.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Sparse multimode preparation and transfer reconstruction can scale polynomially; dense all-to-all mode tomography and uncontrolled material disorder can erase that advantage.

existence.scaling: O(n^3) dense eigensystem or less for sparse local mode models

preparation.scaling: O(n) nominal local resonators/couplers; yield and mode-crowding scaling unmeasured

sampling.scaling: O(k m epsilon^-2) coherent sweeps or lifetime records
sampling.approximationError: drift, finite linewidth and thermal occupation

detection.scaling: O(n k epsilon^-2) for resolved ports; O(n^2 k epsilon^-2) for dense transfer tomography

verification.scaling: O(n^3 + n k epsilon^-2) for model fit plus reversal and scattering controls

cards.independentVerification: Fit splitting and damping from complex transfer data, then predict loop reversal, temperature dependence and a held-out port without refitting.
cards.killTest: The claimed geometric signal is reproduced by loss, gain, skew scattering or unresolved mode crowding within the calibrated nuisance model.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Finite-dimensional non-Hermitian/Floquet reconstruction is polynomial in mode count, settings and precision. This does not identify nonlinear many-body Floquet phases, whose heating and state complexity remain outside the card.

existence.scaling: O(n^3 k) eigensystem or propagator analysis along a discretized loop
existence.approximationError: path discretization and conditioning near exceptional points

preparation.scaling: O(n+k) local elements and programmed loop segments for a sparse carrier

sampling.scaling: O(k m epsilon^-2) forward/reverse and rate sweeps

detection.scaling: O(n^2 k epsilon^-2) worst-case left/right transfer reconstruction

verification.scaling: O(n^3 k + n^2 k epsilon^-2) singular-value, reversal and rate audit

cards.independentVerification: Reconstruct the passive/coherent generator independently of gain/loss, then predict rate and orientation reversal with singular-value controls.
cards.killTest: Endpoint exchange changes under rate reversal in a way fully explained by nonadiabatic gain/loss while the inferred topology is unchanged.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Sparse single-particle defect models and localized-mode detection are polynomial. Interacting defects, continuum control and the claim that a wall transports information beyond an index are not covered by that favorable scaling.

existence.scaling: O(n^3) dense spectral flow or sparse polynomial eigensolvers for a finite carrier

preparation.scaling: O(n) local couplings and one defect profile in a programmable lattice
preparation.approximationError: wall width, disorder and boundary mismatch

sampling.scaling: O(k s) spectral/transport records with s=O(epsilon^-2) baseline

detection.scaling: O(n k epsilon^-2) resolved local intensity/phase records

verification.scaling: O(c n^3) for c homotopic controls plus disorder ensemble

cards.independentVerification: Compare the target defect with homotopic same-index controls that scramble phase, endpoint representation or selector data while preserving mode count.
cards.killTest: Only the protected mode count survives; every proposed extra datum changes under a same-index control or arbitrary boundary choice.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: A fixed p-channel hydrodynamic response fit is polynomial, but deriving its coefficients and spectral rank from a microscopic strongly coupled carrier can inherit an uncontrolled or exponential many-body cost.

existence.scaling: effective response algebra O(p^3 k), microscopic derivation not assigned a general scaling
existence.basis: effective versus microscopic layers kept separate

preparation.scaling: sample and source preparation depends on the chosen fluid/material carrier

sampling.scaling: O(p^2 k epsilon^-2) for all declared auto/cross channels
sampling.approximationError: finite window, correlated noise and long-time tails

detection.approximationError: source/readout mixing and inaccessible stress components

verification.scaling: O(p^3 k) Ward/KMS/positivity residuals plus held-out cross-channel prediction
verification.approximationError: model discrepancy remains separate from statistical error
verification.basis: identity checks and independent perturbation channel

cards.independentVerification: Fit a subset of auto/cross responses, then predict held-out channels while independently checking Ward identities, KMS relations and positivity.
cards.killTest: Distinct hidden spectra remain equivalent after every accessible stress probe, or the inferred rank depends on an unmeasured constitutive component.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Stabilizer/symplectic certification is polynomial, while generic k-logical-qubit tomography scales as 4^k and unrestricted reachability may require exponential search. Source-restricted generators must be certified without universal tomography.

existence.scaling: O(n^3) tableau/group closure for declared Clifford-like generators
existence.approximationError: exact in the finite algebra; excludes generic non-Clifford reachability

preparation.scaling: compiled word length may be polynomial for declared generators but unrestricted synthesis can grow exponentially

sampling.scaling: O(m epsilon^-2) for selected logical witnesses; generic amplitude estimation is not assumed

detection.scaling: generic logical tomography O(4^k epsilon^-2); stabilizer witnesses remain polynomial

verification.scaling: O(poly(n,m,epsilon^-1)) only with generator provenance, randomized/local witnesses and leakage checks
verification.approximationError: certificate covers the restricted reachable group, not all unitaries

cards.independentVerification: Derive generators from the carrier, compile with an independent implementation, and verify the restricted logical action with randomized or stabilizer witnesses plus leakage records.
cards.killTest: Success requires O(4^k) unrestricted tomography, exponential word search, or arbitrary universal controls that erase source provenance.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: Each frozen finite bootstrap or moment relaxation can be polynomial in basis dimension b, but b grows with truncation and no corpus result supplies a uniform convergence rate to the physical amplitude region.

existence.scaling: finite SDP/moment relaxations are polynomial in b at fixed precision; b versus physical accuracy is unproved

preparation.scaling: O(b^2) or greater to assemble moments, crossing equations and known poles for a fixed relaxation

sampling.scaling: O(k epsilon^-2) for held-out cross sections or response points

detection.scaling: O(k p) likelihood evaluation against the allowed region

verification.scaling: repeat under basis enlargement and independent standard-bound derivation; cost polynomial in each b but limit rate unknown

cards.independentVerification: Prove non-reducibility against the standard unitarity/analyticity/causality/positivity basis, then test monotone stability under basis enlargement and held-out data.
cards.killTest: The proposed inequality is a reparameterized standard bound or disappears under the next controlled basis enlargement.

cards.asymptoticConclusion: The four-mode quotient-scar experiment is constant-size and completely certifiable. A larger cyclic family is polynomial for resolved linear readout, but oriented invariants can become severely ill-conditioned; no favorable asymptotic claim is made for them.

existence.scaling: exact constant-size four-mode algebra; generalized n-port linear algebra O(n^3)

preparation.scaling: O(n) resonators and calibrated sparse couplings for a hub-plus-n-outer extension

sampling.scaling: O(k n epsilon^-2) individual and summed complex sweeps plus waiting-time records
sampling.approximationError: drift, nonlinear memory and finite bandwidth

detection.scaling: O(k n epsilon^-2) resolved records; oriented high-degree invariant conditioning is not bounded
detection.approximationError: gain/phase calibration and Vandermonde condition number

verification.scaling: O(n^3 + k n epsilon^-2) linear model challenge, symmetry breaking and cyclic reversal at fixed n

cards.independentVerification: Blindly fit resolved and lumped models, disable detector faces in turn, weakly break cyclic symmetry and require predicted recovery of the two contrast modes and orientation sign.
cards.killTest: No contrast modes exist under individual readout, or gain, bandwidth, relabeling and ordinary hidden-state nuisances explain the linked signature package.
